column1: # p476 accent-folding control, 2026-10-27. Closes Gap 475-Q, which asked for the unaccented control that
# p475 did not run. Query form is p475's exactly: "<token> stars:>=5" on the authenticated search channel.
# READING: the index does NOT fold diacritics symmetrically. The UNACCENTED token returns the LARGER set in
# 3 of 3 language pairs (1.34x-3.50x). An unaccented query matches accented text; an accented query does not
# match unaccented text. Therefore every in-language count published from an ACCENTED token is a LOWER BOUND.
